```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

::: {.column-screen style="padding: 0 20px;"}
```{r}
# 2. Data Loading
data_path <- "../data/survey_data.csv"

if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop(paste("File not found at:", data_path, "\nPlease check your directory path."))
}

# Load the CSV
data <- read_csv(data_path)

# Failsafe: If the CSV doesn't have a 'Has_Photos' column yet, add it temporarily.
if (!"Has_Photos" %in% names(data)) {
  # For now, default everything to "Yes" to prevent the filter from breaking.
  # (See instructions below on how to update your CSV with the real data!)
  data$Has_Photos <- "Yes" 
}

# =========================================================================
# 2.b Dynamic Image URL Construction (For GCloud)
# =========================================================================
# Toggle set to TRUE to use your new GCloud bucket!
use_gcloud_paths <- TRUE

if (use_gcloud_paths) {
  # Your new public Google Cloud Storage bucket URL
  gcs_bucket_url <- "https://storage.googleapis.com/ncrmp-atlantic-photos"
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      # 1. Map Region to shortened abbreviation for directory paths
      CleanRegion = case_when(
        Region == "St. Thomas/John" ~ "STTSTJ",
        Region == "St. Croix" ~ "STX",
        Region == "Puerto Rico" ~ "PRICO",
        TRUE ~ gsub("/", "_", Region) # Fallback just in case there are others
      ),
      
      # 2. Build predictable paths: Bucket / Year / Region / SurveyID / 1.jpg
      Img1 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/1.jpg"),
      Img2 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/2.jpg"),
      Img3 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/3.jpg"),
      Img4 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/4.jpg")
    )
} else {
  # Failsafe: Ensure image columns exist for the GDrive PoC if missing
  for (col in c("Img1", "Img2", "Img3", "Img4")) {
    if (!col %in% names(data)) {
      data[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }
}
# =========================================================================


# 3. Create Shared Data Object (Crosstalk)
shared_data <- SharedData$new(data)

# 4. Create the Map
map <- leaflet(shared_data, width = "100%", height = "60vh") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.OceanBasemap, group = "Ocean Basemap") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Lon, 
    lat = ~Lat,
    radius = 5,                 
    color = "#0073FF",          
    stroke = FALSE,             
    fillOpacity = 0.7,          
    popup = ~paste0(
      # Elegant modern popup container
      "<div style='font-family: \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, \"Helvetica Neue\", Arial, sans-serif; min-width: 220px; padding: 2px;'>",
      
      # Distinct Header with a bottom border matching the marker color
      "<h4 style='margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid #0073FF; color: #2c3e50; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;'>",
      "Survey ID: ", SurveyID, 
      "</h4>",
      
      # Flexbox rows for perfectly aligned label-value pairs
      "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px;'>",
      "<span style='color: #6c757d; font-weight: 500;'>Region:</span>",
      "<span style='color: #212529; font-weight: 600; text-align: right;'>", Region, "</span>",
      "</div>",
      
      "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px;'>",
      "<span style='color: #6c757d; font-weight: 500;'>Year:</span>",
      "<span style='color: #212529; font-weight: 600; text-align: right;'>", Year, "</span>",
      "</div>",
      
      "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px;'>",
      "<span style='color: #6c757d; font-weight: 500;'>Depth:</span>",
      "<span style='color: #212529; font-weight: 600; text-align: right;'>", Depth, " ft</span>",
      "</div>",
      
      "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 14px;'>",
      "<span style='color: #6c757d; font-weight: 500;'>Habitat:</span>",
      "<span style='color: #212529; font-weight: 600; text-align: right;'>", Habitat, "</span>",
      "</div>",
      
      "</div>",
      
      # Hide the images within the popup so our Javascript listener can grab them 
      "<div class='hidden-images' style='display: none;'>",
      "<div style='display: flex; gap: 15px; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between;'>",
      
      # We changed target='_blank' to an onclick function that triggers our new modal window
      ifelse(!is.na(Img1), paste0("<a href='#' onclick='openImageModal(this); return false;' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img1, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(Img2), paste0("<a href='#' onclick='openImageModal(this); return false;' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img2, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(Img3), paste0("<a href='#' onclick='openImageModal(this); return false;' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img3, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(Img4), paste0("<a href='#' onclick='openImageModal(this); return false;' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img4, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      
      "</div></div>"
    ),
    group = "Surveys"
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Ocean Basemap", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c("Surveys"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      this.on('popupopen', function(e) {
        var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
        tempDiv.innerHTML = e.popup.getContent();
        var hiddenImages = tempDiv.querySelector('.hidden-images');
        var panel = document.getElementById('photo-panel');
        if (hiddenImages && panel) {
          panel.innerHTML = hiddenImages.innerHTML;
          // Change the background style of the panel once photos are loaded
          panel.style.border = 'none';
          panel.style.background = 'transparent';
          panel.style.padding = '0'; // Remove padding so images stretch edge-to-edge
        }
      });
    }
  ")

# 5. Assemble the Dashboard with Filters
# We move the photo panel inside the R chunk and group it with the map using tagList
photo_panel <- htmltools::HTML('
  <div id="photo-panel" style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 10px; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 250px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #6c757d; font-family: sans-serif; border: 2px dashed #ccc; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;">
    <h3 style="margin: 0;">Select a survey point on the map to view photos</h3>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Custom Modal Overlay for viewing all 4 photos -->
  <div id="image-modal" style="display: none; position: fixed; z-index: 9999; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: auto; background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);">
    <span onclick="document.getElementById(\'image-modal\').style.display=\'none\'" style="position: fixed; top: 20px; right: 40px; color: #f1f1f1; font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; z-index: 10000;">&times;</span>
    <div id="modal-content" style="margin: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 90%; max-width: 800px; padding: 60px 0; gap: 30px;">
      <!-- JavaScript will dynamically inject the active site images here -->
    </div>
  </div>
  
  <script>
  // Function to open the modal and populate it with images from the clicked container
  function openImageModal(anchorElement) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("image-modal");
    var modalContent = document.getElementById("modal-content");
    modalContent.innerHTML = ""; // Clear out previous images
    
    // Look up to the container to grab all 4 images for this site
    var container = anchorElement.parentNode;
    var images = container.querySelectorAll("img");
    
    images.forEach(function(img) {
      // Only pull images that haven\'t been hidden by our 404 failsafe
      if (img.style.display !== "none" && img.src !== "") {
        var newImg = document.createElement("img");
        newImg.src = img.src;
        newImg.style.width = "100%";
        newImg.style.height = "auto";
        newImg.style.borderRadius = "8px";
        newImg.style.boxShadow = "0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
        modalContent.appendChild(newImg);
      }
    });
    
    // Show the modal
    modal.style.display = "block";
  }
  
  // Close the modal when the user clicks anywhere on the dark background
  window.onclick = function(event) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("image-modal");
    if (event.target === modal) {
      modal.style.display = "none";
    }
  }
  </script>
')

dashboard <- bscols(
  widths = c(2, 10), 
  list(
    filter_select(id = "region_filter", label = "Select Region:", sharedData = shared_data, group = ~Region),
    filter_checkbox(id = "year_filter", label = "Select Year(s):", sharedData = shared_data, group = ~Year, inline = FALSE),
    filter_select(id = "habitat_filter", label = "Select Habitat:", sharedData = shared_data, group = ~Habitat),
    filter_slider(id = "depth_filter", label = "Depth Range (ft):", sharedData = shared_data, column = ~Depth),
    filter_checkbox(id = "photos_filter", label = "Has Photos:", sharedData = shared_data, group = ~Has_Photos, inline = TRUE)
  ),
  htmltools::tagList(
    map,
    photo_panel
  )
)

# 6. Display the Dashboard
dashboard
```
:::
